evals.prompt: I'm starting a new PowerShell module project called 'PSUtilities'. It'll have Public and Private function folders and a tests/ directory with Pester 5 tests. Can you scaffold the full build system using PowerShellBuild — I need build.ps1, psakeFile.ps1, and requirements.psd1. I want code coverage at 80% and PSScriptAnalyzer enabled.
evals.expected_output: Three files: build.ps1 (Bootstrap + Invoke-psake entry point), psakeFile.ps1 (properties block with PSBPreference settings for coverage threshold 0.80 and ScriptAnalysis, tasks using -FromModule PowerShellBuild — no Import-Module PowerShellBuild statement), requirements.psd1 (psake, PowerShellBuild, Pester, PSScriptAnalyzer, platyPS). Structure follows PowerShellBuild conventions.

assertions.name: has_all_three_files
assertions.description: Should generate build.ps1, psakeFile.ps1, and requirements.psd1

assertions.name: uses_from_module
assertions.description: psakeFile.ps1 should use -FromModule PowerShellBuild for task definitions

assertions.name: has_code_coverage_threshold
assertions.description: Code coverage threshold should be set to 0.80 (80%)

assertions.name: has_script_analysis_enabled
assertions.description: PSScriptAnalyzer should be explicitly enabled via PSBPreference

assertions.name: has_required_dependencies
assertions.description: requirements.psd1 should include psake, PowerShellBuild, Pester, and PSScriptAnalyzer

evals.prompt: My PowerShellBuild project builds fine locally but I need to set up GitHub Actions CI. I want it to run tests on every push and PR, then publish to PSGallery automatically when I push to main. The API key should come from a GitHub secret called PSGALLERY_API_KEY.
evals.expected_output: A GitHub Actions workflow YAML with two jobs: test (runs on push/PR, calls ./build.ps1 -Task Test -Bootstrap on windows-latest) and publish (depends on test, only on main branch, passes PSGALLERY_API_KEY secret as env var). Uses actions/checkout@v4.

assertions.name: has_two_jobs
assertions.description: Workflow should have separate test and publish jobs

assertions.name: triggers_on_push_and_pr
assertions.description: Test job should trigger on both push and pull_request events

assertions.name: publish_only_on_main
assertions.description: Publish job should only run on main branch

assertions.name: has_psgallery_secret
assertions.description: PSGALLERY_API_KEY should be passed from GitHub secrets

assertions.name: uses_build_ps1
assertions.description: Workflow should call ./build.ps1 rather than Invoke-psake directly

evals.prompt: I want to use Invoke-Build instead of psake for my PowerShellBuild project. Can you show me how to set up the .build.ps1 file? I need to compile the module into a single PSM1 from Classes, Private, and Public folders, run code coverage, and exclude any .Tests.ps1 files from the build output.
evals.expected_output: A .build.ps1 using Invoke-Build syntax: Import-Module PowerShellBuild -Force, . PowerShellBuild.IB.Tasks, then PSBPreference settings for CompileModule=$true, CompileDirectories=@('Classes','Private','Public'), Exclude=@('*.Tests.ps1'), CodeCoverage.Enabled=$true. Default task set to Build or Test.

assertions.name: uses_ib_tasks
assertions.description: Should use . PowerShellBuild.IB.Tasks to load Invoke-Build tasks

assertions.name: has_compile_directories
assertions.description: CompileDirectories should include Classes, Private, and Public

assertions.name: has_exclude_tests
assertions.description: Exclude pattern should filter out *.Tests.ps1 files

assertions.name: has_code_coverage_enabled
assertions.description: Code coverage should be enabled via PSBPreference
